youtube.title: He Hijacked a Plane and Vanished Forever | D. B. Cooper
youtube.description:
November 24, 1971: a man who called himself "Dan Cooper" hijacked Northwest Orient Flight 305, collected $200,000 and four parachutes, and jumped from the rear stairs over southwest Washington. He was never found. In 1980, $5,800 of the ransom turned up on the Columbia River. The FBI suspended its active investigation in 2016.

📂 Case File #004: D. B. Cooper

Sources: FBI case history (fbi.gov/history/famous-cases/db-cooper-hijacking); overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D._B._Cooper
Images: FBI composite sketches and bulletin; Northwest Orient 727 (1970), public domain via Wikimedia Commons.
Narration voice: AI.
